interface.title: Complex Network Analysis Tool (CNATool), built with MaiaScript and sigma.js
interface.field: Network science / complex networks (social, semantic and neural networks)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory analysis and description of a network that already exists, plus export of its figure and summary statistics
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a network file, draw it with a force-directed or no-overlap layout, compute its global properties (density, average degree, clustering, shortest path, diameter, global efficiency) and per-vertex degree, clustering and centrality, then export the graph or a properties report.

data.note: I loaded semantic-net.json (16 vertices, 27 edges), smallworld-1.net, complete-1.net, random-1.net, scalefree-1.net and hybrid-1.net (50 vertices each), c_elegans_neural_network.net (279 vertices, 4576 edges) and edge-cases.net (8 vertices, 6 edges, with isolated vertices) through File > Open. File > New could not make a graph: every option asks for its settings in prompt dialogs, those prompts were accepted empty, and the result was a 0-vertex graph. The panel then showed Density -NaN and kept the old graph's averages (screens/023.webp). Replay screens are stored under check/screens/ and are cited as check_screens so they do not clash with the explorer's screens/.

features.name: Network canvas with selectable layout algorithm
features.general: Draw a node-link diagram, switch between layout algorithms, set what the marks encode, then zoom, pan and hover to name items
features.specific: sigma.js canvas driven by the Algorithm dropdown (None / Force Atlas 2 / No Overlap), with Show labels, Show weight (edge thickness) and arrowheads for directed edges read from the file; wheel zoom, drag pan, hover shows the vertex label. Dragging single vertices did not move them (screens/034.webp).
steps: load a network
choose a layout in the Algorithm dropdown
turn labels and weight-scaled edges on or off
wheel-zoom and drag to pan
hover a node to read its name
serves_tasks: Show or hide node names and edge weights
Zoom, pan and identify individual nodes

features.name: Global network properties panel
features.general: A side panel of whole-dataset summary statistics that fills in when an option is ticked and updates when a new dataset is loaded
features.specific: Vertices, Edges and Density are always shown; ticking Calculate Properties adds Avg. Degree, Avg. Clustering Coef., Avg. Shortest Path, Diameter and Global Efficiency. Directed Graph changed only Density, and only on semantic-net; with Use GPU ticked the derived values stayed blank (screens/037.webp, screens/038.webp).
steps: load a network (counts and density appear)
tick Calculate Properties
optionally toggle Directed Graph
load the next network to compare values
serves_tasks: Switch how density is computed for directed edges
Contrast summary statistics across reference network models

features.name: Per-item report tables in new tabs
features.general: Open a table of measures for every item in its own tab, one table per kind of measure
features.specific: The View menu opens Properties summary (with degree distribution), Vertices degrees (out/in/total), Vertices clustering and Vertices centralities (geodesics, closeness, betweenness, normalised closeness and betweenness). Caveats: for a JSON network the per-vertex reports showed only headers (screens/012.webp); in the replay Betweenness was -NaN for every vertex.
steps: load a network and tick Calculate Properties
pick a report from the View menu
read the table in the new tab
close it and pick the next report
serves_tasks: Read the summary with its degree distribution

features.name: Multi-format export menu
features.general: Save the current dataset in exchange formats, the figure as vector graphics, and the statistics as a shareable report
features.specific: File > Save > Pajek File (.net with layout x/y), JSON File (sigma graph with render coordinates), Graph File (.svg of the canvas), Report File (.html properties table and degree distribution). The kept screen shows only the menu; file contents were read as text, not captured.
steps: open File > Save
choose Pajek, JSON, Graph or Report
the browser downloads a file named after the loaded network
serves_tasks: Save the network and its figure and statistics as files
